description: A white paper cup sits in the center with a toothbrush standing in it, and a small toothpaste tube lies on the tabletop in front. The right hand reaches forward to pull the toothbrush out of the cup and holds it over the table while the left hand picks up the toothpaste tube, twists off the cap, and squeezes a strip of toothpaste onto the toothbrush bristles, then both hands lower the items and the right hand places the toothbrush back into the cup.
